packages.name: pypdfium2
flags: Core dependency from CP11 S11.1 (decisions 0060, 0061): page text, character offsets and quote digests of PDFs. The wheel's own metadata declares 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses'. It bundles a PDFium binary: PDFium itself under its BSD-style licence (BUILD_LICENSES/pdfium.txt) and the pdfium-binaries build scripts under MIT (BUILD_LICENSES/pdfium-binaries.txt), built with third-party libraries whose notices the wheel ships under licenses/data/<platform>/BUILD_LICENSES (abseil, agg23, fast_float, FreeType, ICU, Little CMS, libjpeg-turbo, OpenJPEG, libpng, libtiff, llvm-libc, simdutf, zlib), plus CC-BY-4.0 for documentation data. The notice set is per platform; this register records the windows_x64 one. All must be carried into an installer's notices file before any public release (E08). PDFium parses untrusted PDFs in a separate process (src/prometheos/library/extract_worker.py).
